schema.text: When you walk or use a wheelchair, what do you do when the air is bad (exhaust fumes, dust, bad smells)?

options.text: I notice it, but I don't change anything
I protect myself, e.g. with a mask
I travel another way (e.g. by bus instead of on foot)

schema.help: Think about the parts of a journey you make along streets or pavements, on foot or using a wheelchair. If you do more than one of these, choose what you do most often.

en.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: When you walk or use a wheelchair, what do you do when the air is bad (exhaust fumes, dust, bad smells)?
en.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: I notice it, but I don't change anything
en.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: I travel another way (e.g. by bus instead of on foot)
en.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: I protect myself, e.g. with a mask
en.#Think about the parts of a journey you: Think about the parts of a journey you make along streets or pavements, on foot or using a wheelchair. If you do more than one of these, choose what you do most often.

it.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Quando ti sposti a piedi o in sedia a rotelle, cosa fai quando l’aria è cattiva (gas di scarico, polvere, cattivi odori)?
it.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Me ne accorgo, ma non cambio nulla
it.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Mi sposto in un altro modo (ad es. in autobus invece che a piedi)
it.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: Mi proteggo, ad es. con una mascherina
it.#Think about the parts of a journey you: Pensa ai tratti che percorri lungo la strada o sul marciapiede, a piedi o in carrozzina. Se fai più di una di queste cose, scegli quella che fai più spesso.
it.#I travel at another time: Mi sposto in un altro orario

fr.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Lorsque vous marchez ou vous déplacez en fauteuil roulant, que faites-vous quand l’air est mauvais (gaz d’échappement, poussière, mauvaises odeurs) ?
fr.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Je le remarque, mais je ne change rien
fr.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Je me déplace autrement (par ex. en bus plutôt qu'à pied)
fr.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: Je me protège, par ex. avec un masque
fr.#Think about the parts of a journey you: Pensez aux parties du trajet que vous parcourez dans la rue ou sur le trottoir, à pied ou en fauteuil roulant. Si vous faites plusieurs de ces choses, choisissez celle que vous faites le plus souvent.
fr.#I travel at another time: Je me déplace à un autre horaire

de.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Was tun Sie beim Gehen oder Fahren im Rollstuhl, wenn die Luft schlecht ist (Abgase, Staub, schlechte Gerüche)?
de.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Ich merke es, ändere aber nichts
de.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Ich nutze ein anderes Verkehrsmittel (z. B. Bus statt zu Fuß)
de.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: Ich schütze mich, z. B. mit einer Maske
de.#Think about the parts of a journey you: Denken Sie an die Wegabschnitte, die Sie auf Straßen oder Gehwegen zu Fuß oder im Rollstuhl zurücklegen. Wenn Sie mehrere dieser Dinge tun, wählen Sie das aus, was Sie am häufigsten tun.
de.#I travel at another time: Ich fahre oder gehe zu einer anderen Zeit los

tr.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Yürürken veya tekerlekli sandalyeyle ilerlerken hava kötü olduğunda (egzoz dumanı, toz, kötü kokular) ne yaparsınız?
tr.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: Fark ederim ama hiçbir şeyi değiştirmem
tr.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Başka bir şekilde giderim (örn. yürümek yerine otobüsle)
tr.#Think about the parts of a journey you: Yolculuğunuzun sokaklarda veya kaldırımlarda yürüyerek ya da tekerlekli sandalyeyle yaptığınız bölümlerini düşünün. Bunlardan birden fazlasını yapıyorsanız en sık yaptığınızı seçin.

fa.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: هنگام پیاده‌روی یا حرکت با ویلچر، وقتی هوا آلوده است (دود اگزوز، گردوغبار، بوی بد) چه می‌کنید؟
fa.#Nothing, it doesn't affect me: هیچ کاری، بر من اثری ندارد
fa.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: متوجه می‌شوم، اما چیزی را تغییر نمی‌دهم
fa.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: با روش دیگری سفر می‌کنم (مثلاً با اتوبوس به جای پیاده)
fa.#I protect myself, e.g. with a mask: از خودم محافظت می‌کنم، مثلاً با ماسک
fa.#Think about the parts of a journey you: بخش‌هایی از سفر را در نظر بگیرید که در خیابان یا پیاده‌رو، پیاده یا با ویلچر طی می‌کنید. اگر بیش از یکی از این کارها را انجام می‌دهید، کاری را انتخاب کنید که بیشتر انجام می‌دهید.

hu.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: Gyaloglás vagy kerekesszékes közlekedés közben mit tesz, ha rossz a levegő (kipufogógáz, por, kellemetlen szagok)?
hu.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: Más módon utazom (pl. busszal gyalog helyett)
hu.#Think about the parts of a journey you: Gondoljon az utazás azon szakaszaira, amelyeket az utcán vagy a járdán gyalog vagy kerekesszékkel tesz meg. Ha ezek közül többet is tesz, válassza azt, amit a leggyakrabban tesz.

ar.#When you walk or use a wheelchair, what: عند المشي أو التنقل بكرسي متحرك، ما تصرّفك عندما يكون الهواء سيئًا (عوادم المركبات أو الغبار أو الروائح الكريهة)؟
ar.#I notice it, but I don't change anythin: ألاحظ ذلك، لكنني لا أغيّر شيئًا
ar.#I travel another way (e.g. by bus inste: أتنقل بطريقة أخرى (مثلًا بالحافلة بدل المشي)
ar.#Think about the parts of a journey you: فكّر في أجزاء الرحلة التي تقطعها في الشارع أو على الرصيف، مشيًا أو باستخدام كرسي متحرك. إذا كنت تفعل أكثر من أمر من هذه الأمور، فاختر ما تفعله غالبًا.
